classification.analysis: repo-tracker is a personal GitHub automation tool that generates an auto-updated index and dashboard of all of a user's repositories, including fork-sync status against upstream (auto-rebase vs. conflict needing manual fix). A Node.js script (`scripts/sync.js`) runs on a GitHub Actions schedule to rebase forks where possible, flag conflicts, and write a summary table (repo counts, stars, languages, sync status) into both a JSON index and a profile README embed. Built for the owner's own use to keep dozens of tracked forks up to date and surface which ones need manual attention.

use_cases.title: Auto-rebase tracked GitHub forks against upstream on a schedule and flag merge conflicts
Generate a live repo-index dashboard embedded in a GitHub profile README
